faqs.q: Why do garage door cables often fail on homes in Oak Park?
faqs.a: Garage door cables in Oak Park often fail due to the significant temperature swings and moisture common in the Chicagoland area. The frequent changes from hot, humid summers to cold, snowy winters can cause cables to expand, contract, and corrode. This is especially true for the older, detached alley garages prevalent with architecturally protected Victorians and Prairie-style homes. Road salt and general wear also contribute to cable fatigue, leading to fraying, snapping, or coming off the drum. These conditions stress the cables over time, particularly in areas like the Harrison Arts District.
